summary: Graphene & Solar Technologies Ltd filed an 8-K reporting the resignation of director Charles Wantrup and interim company secretary Kristine Woo, effective June 29, 2026, with no disagreement cited. The board simultaneously appointed Daniel Kennedy and Theresa Jester as directors effective June 26, 2026, and Paul Saffron as company secretary effective June 29, 2026. The changes appear routine, not forced or abrupt. No compensation terms beyond the standard non-employee director program were disclosed, and no advisors or arrangements were named. Given the voluntary nature and lack of conflict, this is classified as a routine board refreshment, not a special situation. No deal terms apply.
